title.es: Aquel en el que Fina se marcha de Toledo
title.en: The One Where Fina Leaves Toledo

description.es: Fina se marcha de Toledo. Marta lee la carta de despedida de Fina y queda deshecha. Le dice a Pelayo que Fina se ha ido y que tienen que buscarla. Pelayo propone contratar a un detective para investigar la marcha de Fina. Marta le dice a Damián que Fina se ha ido.
description.en: Fina leaves Toledo. Marta reads Fina's farewell letter and is shattered. She tells Pelayo that Fina has left and that they need to look for her. Pelayo suggests hiring a detective to investigate Fina's departure. Marta tells Damián that Fina has left.
